sources.title: Pilot database decision
sources.text: For Kestrel's pilot deployment, the team selected one local SQLite database. A PostgreSQL migration is deferred until multi-user requirements are demonstrated.

sources.title: Workshop equipment measurement
sources.text: The workshop printer draws 650 watts while heating its nozzle and bed.

sources.title: Communication preference
sources.text: Mira prefers short written updates with the decision in the opening sentence.

sources.title: Restore procedure
sources.text: Before replacing the Cedar service database, create a backup and verify that it can be restored in a separate temporary directory.

sources.title: Release ownership note A
sources.text: For the September 2026 Cedar release, Noor is the sole owner of production sign-off.

sources.title: Release ownership note B
sources.text: For the September 2026 Cedar release, Luis is the sole owner of production sign-off.

sources.title: Archive location
sources.text: The Atlas archive is stored in cabinet B-17 in the west workshop.

sources.title: Lunch offering
sources.text: The restaurant menu offers mushroom soup at lunchtime.

sources.title: Upload decision
sources.text: For Kestrel's pilot, the team decided that sending customer transcripts to an external cloud service requires the customer's written permission.
